_head: The measurements behind this folder's tokens, replayable. Boxes are design pt at 3 capture px to the pt; run with --pt 3. `img` is assets/refs/pN.png, the Nth Mobbin capture of the adding-a-new-data-source flow with its 120px bottom banner cropped off -- the refs are third-party and are not committed, so rebuild them before replaying. --against wants a directory holding the boards rendered at 3x with --crop-phone; every probe names its own file there.
